name: Mbiresaurus
sum: Mbiresaurus is a basal sauropodomorph from the Late Triassic (Carnian) Pebbly Arkose Formation of Zimbabwe, one of the earliest definite dinosaurs of Africa.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: NHMZ 2222, a mostly complete, partly articulated skeleton found in 2017 and 2019 in the Pebbly Arkose Formation, Mbire District, Zimbabwe.
material: The holotype (partial skull and lower jaws, neck, back, sacral and tail vertebrae, ribs, parts of girdles and limbs) and a larger referred specimen, NHMZ 2547.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted; Griffin et al. (2022) recovered it as a basal sauropodomorph.
author: Griffin et al. 2022

sources.text: Griffin, Christopher T.; Wynd, Brenen M.; Munyikwa, Darlington; Broderick, Tim J.; Zondo, Michel; Tolan, Stephen; Langer, Max C.; Nesbitt, Sterling J.; Taruvinga, Hazel R. 2022. Africa's oldest dinosaurs reveal early suppression of dinosaur distribution. Nature 609(7926): 313–319. doi:10.1038/s41586-022-05133-x
